title: Nevers Pharmacy owned by Graydon Nevers opened in 1967
description: Graydon E. Nevers began working at Aiton Drug Company after graduating from high school in the fall of 1946. He became a pharmacist in 1955 and returned to Aiton Drug Company. On November 11, 1967, Graydon purchased the pharmacy portion of the store, keeping the wholesale business separate. That same month, he moved the drug store into the original post office building across the street and renamed it Nevers Pharmacy Rexall Drug Store. The drug store operated there until 1986 (when it was owned by his son, Glen), when the business relocated to the Hartland Courtyard Mall.
